k:認.mnemonic: With a sword (刀) held over his heart (心), he has to say (言) it out loud: yes, it was me. Acknowledge (recognize, witness, discern).

k:百.mnemonic: One (一) line over white (白): add one more year and the hair is completely white, the age of a full century. Hundred.
k:百.hint: White hair at a full century.

k:優.mnemonic: A leader (亻) who never thinks of self (自): forehead (冖) down, he will trudge (夂) a hundred (百) miles with a kind heart (心) for others. Better than the rest. Superior (gentle, excellent, actor).

k:命.mnemonic: An order made to suit (合) you exactly, sealed with the king's stamp (卩). You cannot argue with it. Fate (command, decree, destiny).
k:命.hint: A sealed order just for you.

k:宮.mnemonic: A roof (宀) with so much history (史) beneath it: room upon room where kings and princesses have lived. Palace (shrine, princess).

k:岡.mnemonic: A fenced outline with a little mountain tucked inside it under a pair of horns: a small rounded rise, not tall enough to poke out. Knoll (hill, mount).
k:岡.hint: A small rise inside a frame.

k:歌.mnemonic: You can (可), you can: whatever you lack (欠) in skill, open your mouth wide and belt it out anyway. Song (sing).

k:総.mnemonic: A thread (糸) runs through every public (公) heart (心) and gathers them into one tassel: all of them, the whole. Overall (general, whole, all).

k:疑.mnemonic: A hunter with a spoon (匕) for a knife, an arrow (矢) but no bow, a dog in a muzzle (マ) and a bolt (疋) of cloth for a net. Is he really a hunter? Doubt (suspect, distrust, be suspicious).

k:説.mnemonic: Whatever the subject, elder brother (兄) will say (言) what he thinks about it and then explain it at length. Opinion (theory, explanation, rumor).

k:協.mnemonic: Ten (十) people and power (力) three times over: many strengths added up, all pulling on the same rope. Co- (cooperation).

k:敬.mnemonic: Lay flowers (艹), speak one careful phrase (句), and strike (攵) the bell once: how to greet an elder at the shrine. Respect (awe, honor, revere).

k:警.mnemonic: Say (言) it with respect (敬), but say it firmly: stop, and do not do that again. The officer's warning. Admonish (police, warn, commandment).

k:是.mnemonic: The day (日) sun stands over a bolt (疋) of cloth laid dead straight, without a wrinkle: exactly right. Just so (this, right, justice).

k:題.mnemonic: At the top of the page (頁) one line says what it is about, placed just so (是): the heading. Topic (subject).

k:色.mnemonic: A hooked brush dipping into a wide pot, with a curled tail of paint running out underneath. Color.
k:色.hint: A brush dipped in a paint pot.

k:葉.mnemonic: Between the flowers (艹) on top and the tree (木) below sits a generation (世): every year a new generation of green comes out, then drops. Leaf (plane, lobe, needle).
k:葉.hint: Each year's new green on the branch.

k:賞.mnemonic: The best member (員) of the club gets a sparkle (⺌) of gold tied round the forehead (冖): the winner's crown. Prize (award, reward, praise).
k:賞.hint: A gold band for the winner.

k:達.mnemonic: A sheep (羊) led down the path (辶) and across the soil (土) all the way to market without losing it once. The shepherd has made it. Accomplished (reach, arrive, attain).
k:達.hint: The sheep reaches market at last.

k:研.mnemonic: Rub the blade on a stone (石) twenty (廾) times, then ten thousand (万) times more, until it shines. Polish (study of, sharpen).
k:研.hint: Rubbing a blade until it shines.

k:花.mnemonic: Among the flowers (艹), a tight green bud will transform (化) overnight into a burst of petals. Flower.

k:挙.mnemonic: A hand (手) shoots up into the air with a sparkle (⺌) above it: me, pick me! Raise (plan, nominate, project).

k:録.mnemonic: A servant (隶) scratches every payment into a plate of gold (金), so that it is written down and can never be rubbed out. Record.

k:告.mnemonic: Dig in the soil (土) and history (史) comes up out of it: buried things that tell what really happened. Revelation (tell, inform, announce).

k:豆.mnemonic: A bowl on a stemmed stand with a lid line on top, the kind that holds a little pile of round things. Beans (pea, midget).
k:豆.hint: A stemmed bowl of small round things.

k:頭.mnemonic: The teacher counts each member (員) of the class like beans (豆), tapping each one on the crown and marking the page (頁): so many of these in the room. Head.
k:頭.hint: Counting the class by tapping crowns.

k:歩.mnemonic: Stop (止), then a few (少) steps, then stop again: one foot, pause, other foot. Not running. Walk.
k:歩.hint: A few steps, pause, a few more.
